nodes.label: Prompt #14: Internationalization & Theme System Specification
nodes.rationale: Wires up the design system from Prompt #3 with user preferences from Prompt #6 to prepare SilverChat for multi-language (en, es) and multi-theme (light/dark/system + 6 accents) support without translating existing components inline.

nodes.label: src/lib/i18n.ts (i18next Configuration)
nodes.rationale: Configures i18next with react-i18next and i18next-browser-languagedetector across 9 namespaces and 2 languages (en, es). Sets useSuspense: false to avoid breaking React Router and TanStack suspense boundaries, normalizes regional browser locales (e.g. es-MX to es), and must be imported first in main.tsx before any component calls t().

nodes.label: src/types/i18n.d.ts (TypeScript i18next Definitions)
nodes.rationale: Provides compile-time type safety for t() calls across all 9 translation namespaces using English locale JSON schemas as the canonical type source.

nodes.label: src/lib/theme.ts (Theme & Accent Helpers)
nodes.rationale: Separates theme mode (data-theme='dark' attribute only for explicit dark since light is :root default in Prompt #3 CSS) and accent color (theme-{accent} class on <html>) as two independent dimensions, wrapping localStorage access in try/catch for Safari private mode.

nodes.label: src/hooks/useTheme.ts
nodes.rationale: Manages runtime theme and accent state with dual persistence (immediate localStorage + 500ms debounced user_settings DB update to prevent rapid accent previews from hammering the database) and attaches a prefers-color-scheme media query listener only when theme === 'system'.

nodes.label: src/hooks/useLanguage.ts
nodes.rationale: Synchronizes active language across i18next, localStorage, and Supabase user_settings (with 500ms debounce and post-login override for cross-device consistency).

nodes.label: src/hooks/useFormatters.ts (Intl Locale Formatters)
nodes.rationale: Uses native browser Intl APIs (DateTimeFormat, RelativeTimeFormat with numeric: 'auto' for natural strings like 'yesterday', NumberFormat) instead of external date libraries to keep bundle size small while remaining reactive to i18n.language.

nodes.label: src/app/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx
nodes.rationale: Replaces the stub ThemeProvider from Prompt #2 with a real context provider exposing theme, accent, setTheme, and setAccent via useThemeContext.

nodes.label: src/app/providers/I18nProvider.tsx
nodes.rationale: Replaces the stub I18nProvider from Prompt #2 by wrapping the application in react-i18next's I18nextProvider.

nodes.label: index.html Inline FOUC Prevention Script
nodes.rationale: Must be inline and synchronous before any stylesheet or module script in index.html so that data-theme, theme-{accent}, and lang attributes are applied on <html> before the first CSS paint, preventing a flash of unstyled/wrong-themed content.

nodes.label: src/features/settings/components/AppearanceScreen.tsx
nodes.rationale: Replaces the stub AppearanceScreen from Prompt #6, wiring useThemeContext, useLanguage, and useTranslation so users can interactively switch theme mode, OKLCH accent color, and UI language.

nodes.label: 18 Locale JSON Files (9 Namespaces x en/es)
nodes.rationale: Organizes all UI translations into 9 domain namespaces (common, auth, chats, messages, calls, communities, novedades, settings, errors) across English and Spanish using native i18next _one/_other pluralization.

nodes.label: Dual Persistence Pattern (localStorage + Supabase user_settings)
nodes.rationale: Persists theme, accent, and language to localStorage for instant pre-auth/offline boot and FOUC prevention, while syncing with Supabase user_settings (which overrides localStorage on login) as the cross-device source of truth.

nodes.label: src/app/main.tsx (Entry Point i18n Initialization)
nodes.rationale: Imports ./lib/i18n as the very first statement before React and App so i18next is initialized before any module or component invokes t().
